passages.provision_quote: the division shall not approve any notice of intention under Section 3203 within a health protection zone, except for approvals of notices of intention necessary for any of the following purposes: (1) To prevent or respond to a threat to public health, safety, or the environment. (2) To comply with a court order finding that denying approval would amount to a taking of property, or a court order otherwise requiring approval of a notice of intention. (3) To plug and abandon or reabandon a well, including an intercept well necessary to plug and abandon or reabandon a well.
passages.note: Bars new drilling notices only within 3,200-foot health protection zones around sensitive receptors, not jurisdiction-wide, matching the annex's partial-geographic-limit hard case under rung 2.

rows.reasoning: SB 1137 bars approval of new drilling notices of intention only within 3,200-foot health protection zones around sensitive receptors, not across the jurisdiction. The annex treats a siting limit on new wells as on-question (it is about new drilling) but, because it covers only part of the jurisdiction, direction-only rather than 'allow no new drilling and let production decline over time.'
